Marian and the Commander push through the lake area with practiced ease and arrive at the new city. She slows down, overcome by a strange sense of déjà vu.
"What's wrong? Do you see something?"
He walks over to her and glances at her.
"Marian?"
She gazes at the sunlight showering over his head. The sun hangs high in the clear blue sky.
"Are you not... feeling well?"
She looks into his eyes. They're filled with concern, which for some reason feels familiar.

2302.text:
"It's... nothing."
"Yeah? Should we head in, then?"
She's heard those words before.
"..."
Marian smiles once again to reassure him.
"Yeah, let's go."
The two of them walk into the new city together.

2303.text:
There is nothing they can do about this dreadful corruption or their mission right now. Even if they managed to escape the mission area, there's no telling when she might become corrupted or get killed by a Rapture. The surface is far too dangerous.
If they ever hope to make it somewhere safe where they can dream of a future together, they have to accomplish their purpose here—their false purpose.
That's why Marian has decided to keep moving forward, all the while imagining their future together.
"I've thought of something I want to do, Commander."
He gazes at her curiously. "Oh? What is it?"

2304.text:
Marian wants to break free from this relentless cycle, from this false purpose that she isn't even sure will ever end. For just one day, she wishes she could talk with the Commander about how they'll go on living, instead of whether they'll die.
Just once, she wants them to be happy together.

options.text: Ask him to run away together.

condition.hint: What if Maria had broken free of the cycle within her memories?

2305.text:
The Commander walks through the downtown area.
"Whoa... there's a lot of buildings here that are still intact. We should probably find somewhere to set up base first. What do you think?"
She recognizes that excited look on his face from somewhere.
"..."
Marian stares intently at his face.
"Marian?"
"Hm?"
"What's wrong? You've been spacing out all..."
Just then, a loud crash rings through the air.
"Gah... An ambush!"
A pack of ground-type Raptures come charging in.

2306.text:
After all their past encounters, they're both now adept at handling ambushes like this.
"Phew... At least there's not another Black Smith."
Something about his relief seems familiar.
"Yeah..." she responds.

2307.text:
"You've looked a little out of it since earlier. Are you okay?"
"Oh... Yes, of course. I must be a little nervous since I'm still unfamiliar with this city."
The Commander looks at her worriedly before glancing around. "If you're feeling that anxious, do you want to find a place we can use as a trap first?"
Yet another wave of déjà vu washes over her.
"Or, since we don't know how long we'll be staying here, maybe we should start by securing some food."
When has she heard this?
Why doesn't she have any memory of it?
And how is that even possible?
"... Marian?"

options.text: Ask if he's ever said any of this before.

2308.text:
"Have I ever said any of this before? Uh... I'm not sure."
Fear flickers across his troubled face for a split second. She sees it and...

options.text: Remembers seeing a similar look on his face before.

condition.hint: Fight off the Raptures at the convenience store in the old downtown district.

2309.text:
"Marian. Are you really feeling all right?"
"Of... course. I'm fine."
Unable to remember anything, Marian feels a subtle sense of unease as she follows after the Commander.

2310.text:
Marian remembers the day she saw fear on his face.
It was when they stopped by the convenience store in the old downtown district to look for the cat. She had this feeling she couldn't quite describe, and made a choice she normally wouldn't have. Ordinarily, she would've waited inside the convenience store until the Raptures passed by.
Had she not diverged from her usual pattern that day, what would have happened? What could have happened that is so terrifying?

2311.text:
When Marian falls silent, the Commander hurriedly continues.
"Well, I'm sure I've said something in a similar vein before. We've been through a lot, after all. But anyway, why don't we get moving? There's no telling when more Raptures will show up."
She watches him frantically change the subject and...

options.text: Remembers seeing him acting similarly before.

condition.hint: Try heading up the outer wall of the collapsed building by the lake.

2312.text:
She remembers the day she noticed his frantic behavior.
He normally would never have chosen to climb up that building, but he scaled it as if desperately trying to protect her from some terrible death. And the thought reminds her of how she couldn't remember what happened after the Black Smith's tentacle grazed her that one time.
The Black Smith. Tentacles. Gaps in her memory.
Was that really the only time her memory had been erased?

2313.text:
"Marian?"
He looks at her, his eyes full of worry at her continued silence. She looks into his eyes and...

options.text: Remembers seeing a similar sentiment before.

condition.hint: Advance cautiously in the more open parts of the forest north of the lake.

2314.text:
She remembers the day she saw his eyes so full of concern.
It was when they had ventured into the more open part of the forest, north of the lake. They were fighting Raptures, and it was taking longer than they anticipated.
"Hm... Still okay," he had said, gazing at her with worry in his eyes.
What did he mean by that? Was something going to happen, something that would make things not okay? What kind of change could he have been so worried about?
When he said that, she realizes he was looking at...

options.text: Her. He was looking right at her.

2315.text:
A change in Marian herself that the Commander is afraid of. Gaps in her memory.
Suddenly, Marian recalls a conversation she once had with Doctor Maria.
"You... Stop getting corrupted."
What the doctor said confused Marian at the time.
"Oh, right... The moment you're corrupted, the data stops updating. You wouldn't remember."
"... Oh." Suddenly, Marian understands.
Corrupted.
She was corrupted. That's why she has all these gaps in her memory.
But then, when she became fully corrupted...
"Marian?"
... What happened to the Commander?

2316.text:
The ground begins to rumble.
"Argh... We'll be in for trouble if we stick around here. Let's move somewhere else," the Commander suggests.
"No. We should dispatch them before we go."
"... Marian?"
"I'll be right back, Commander."
"Marian?!"
She sprints forward. She starts fighting the Raptures, the same kinds she must've fought hundreds of times by now. She sees them charge toward the Commander, and it dawns on her.
Raptures kill humans.
Corruption causes a Nikke to think like a Rapture.
Once an unknown amount of time passes, Marian herself becomes corrupted.
All of these thoughts come together to produce a single conclusion in her head: she has been getting corrupted and killing the Commander.
"Hngh... Aghhh... Aggghhh...!"
Desperately holding back her tears, Marian destroys every single Rapture rushing toward the Commander.

2317.text:
After some time passes, Marian and the Commander manage to take down the entire swarm of Raptures and make their way into a nearby building that seems safe.
"Phew... That was close."
They set up a decoy, and then hide on the top floor and look out the window.
"It's already getting late," the Commander observes. "The sun is setting."
The sky glows golden.
"Yeah. Already..."
Something tells Marian that she doesn't have much time left. This very moment might soon be erased from her memory.
She decides to...

2318.text:
"Commander."
Marian walks up to the window and looks at the Commander.
"Marian...?"
He looks at her, only to be met with her eyes gradually turning red.
"What...?! It's too soon..." he says, unable to hide his shock.
"You've known this whole time, huh? That I eventually get corrupted."
"H-how did you...?"
"Commander." Golden light cascades down behind Marian, just like the day they saw this city for the very first time. "You said you wanted a future with me before. Is that still how you feel?"
"Marian."
"Please. It's not like I'm going to really remember whatever happens now. So please, in this moment, be honest with me." Marian gazes pleadingly at him. "Do you still want to share your future with me?"
"Yeah."
"Even though you don't know when I'll get corrupted again?"
"That's okay."
"Even though I might kill you again?"
"That's okay too. None of that matters."
"Why not?"
He smiles at her, just as he did on that day when the golden light shone on him. "Because I love you."

2319.text:
"Oh...!"
Marian hates herself for feeling so relieved, and yet...
"I'm glad to hear that..."
... She is overjoyed. She beams at the fact that he still loves her despite knowing the truth.
She is happy.
Whether or not she remembers any of this, it's enough for her right now to know how he feels.
"That makes me so happy."

2320.text:
"Commander, will you run away with me?"
"... What?"
Her eyes shine with pleading as she looks at him. "Just for one day... or even just for a moment. I want to escape this cruel cycle and just live today with you."
"Marian..."
"I don't want to run from or worry about Raptures, or head into danger. I want to live a life where we get to think about small worries, like what to do today, and what we'll do tomorrow. It doesn't even matter to me if it's just a false sense of happiness, or only a fleeting moment of happiness. I don't know when our end will come, but it's inevitable anyway... then why don't we leave the mission area and run away together, just for one day?"
She doesn't hold back as she expresses her desire to break free from this cycle and be happy with him.
"... Yeah. Let's do it. Let's run away together." The Commander decides to go along with her wish, to risk his life and forge a new path for the woman he loves, just like he has always done.
"Thank you, Commander..."

2321.text: Marian can't come up with a plan for escape. She decides to consider a different approach.

2322.text:
Marian and the Commander run in the opposite direction of the target location.
"We'll see a mountain a little bit ahead of here! Once we get there, we should be able to cross over to the other side!"
"What's the first thing you want to do once we get out?" the Commander asks.
"I'm not sure..." Marian ponders for a long while before breaking into a contented smile. "Hehe, I think I'll be happy doing anything as long as it's with you. What about you?"
"I feel the same." He smiles back. "As long as I'm with you, I'll be happy no matter what we do."
"Want to hurry, then?"
"Yeah, let's go!"
With happiness in their hearts made all the more precious from having a time limit, the two finally leave the mission area behind and run toward a happier today...

3002.text: Before stepping into the old downtown district, No. 7 thinks of the events that led him here.

3003.text:
One hour ago...
No. 7 wakes up in the dormitory of the research facility.
"Where... am I?"
He doesn't remember where this is or why he's here.
"... Marian?"
He looks around, but she's nowhere to be found.
"Marian!"
Still no sign of her. He can't leave her alone in an unknown place. He scrambles out of bed and rushes out of the dormitory.

3004.text:
No. 7 wanders around the research facility. No matter how much he looks, he can't find Marian. Oddly enough, he can't really remember what happened yesterday, or even before that.
"What's wrong with me...?"
He shakes his head.
"I can't just stand here and do nothing. I need to find Marian..."
Something catches his eye.
"Wait, that's the..."
He spots the transport ship, its door left wide open.
"But why is the door...? Did Marian head over first? She shouldn't go alone... If she does, [[REDACT]]that Black Smith[[/REDACT]] will..."
He stops.
"Wait, why can't I remember? Marian and I, we were chased by..."
He doesn't remember.
"Huh...?"
He can't recall his memories with Marian.
"What's going on...? I promised I wouldn't forget... Oh, come on. I can't forget...!"
He frantically boards the transport ship. The door closes behind him.
"No. 7?!" Doctor Maria runs over in shock. "Where are you going?! Stop!"
The transport ship departs for its destination.

3101.text: Snapping out of the flashback, No. 7 gazes out at the old downtown district once again. He needs to go somewhere to keep himself from forgetting Marian, but he isn't sure where.

condition.hint: You have to remember the dream you talked about with Marian.

3102.text:
This isn't good. He can't remember anything.
Agony starts to fill his heart as panic sets in.

3103.text:
He recalls a conversation with Marian.
"I'd like to live until my hair turns [[REDACT]]gray[[/REDACT]]."
He had gazed at her, surprised.
"If we're going to [[REDACT]]live tog[[/REDACT]]ether until our [[REDACT]]hair turns gr[[/REDACT]]ay, we should at least [[REDACT]]get married[[/REDACT]], right?
"As for the [[REDACT]]venue[[/REDACT]]..."
That's when Marian looked into the distance.
"Way over there... It looks like there's a church. It'd be nice to hold it somewhere like that, don't you think?"
He looks up.
"She mentioned a church... That's where I should go."
Refusing to let his memories of Marian slip away, No. 7 steps into the old downtown district.

3104.text: He feels a familiar rumble as soon as he enters the district.

3105.text:
He fires his gun, surprising even himself. Without really thinking, he acted exactly as he used to when Marian was by his side.
"What is wrong with me?! Did I really just pick a fight without Marian here...?"
Unsurprisingly, a human alone can't take on a pack of Raptures without a Nikke. He hears the sound of a laser firing.
"No...!"
The Rapture's beam strikes No. 7...

3106.text:
Without Marian, engaging Raptures alone as a human is an act of suicide. Also, he has this nagging feeling that he won't retain his memories now when he dies.
"... I have to run away."
Drawing on his past experiences, No. 7 quickly slips away.

3108.text:
No. 7 jolts awake and opens his eyes. He pulls himself up to his feet near the entrance of the old downtown district.
"Did I... doze off?"
He hits his face with his fist.
"Snap out of it. I can't just let myself forget everything. I can't let myself forget... Marian."
He looks ahead.
"I need to hurry."
He steps into the old downtown district.

3109.text:
No. 7 makes it to the plaza downtown and searches for the path that leads to the lake. However...
"How did we get there again...?"
... Oddly enough, he can't seem to remember the way. He clutches his head.
"Remember... Come on, you have to remember! Please...!"
Just as he forces himself to concentrate, he hears a gentle meow.
He looks up to see a black cat standing near the entrance to the commercial district.
"Is that a cat...?"

3110.text:
Once, while they were in the old downtown district, Marian had mentioned wanting to stop by someplace:
"I'd like to [[REDACT]]go see[[/REDACT]]... a cat... There's this cat that showed me the way [[REDACT]]to the lake[[/REDACT]]. I'd like to [[REDACT]]check on it[[/REDACT]] if I can..."
"Is that the same cat...?" he wonders to himself.
Letting out another soft meow, the cat turns around and begins to walk off somewhere.
"It looks like it wants me to follow it..."

3111.text: Right now, even the faintest glimmer of hope is worth pursuing. No. 7 quickly follows after the cat.

3112.text: He shouldn't follow a cat he's never seen before. No. 7 hesitates, and when he finally looks up, the cat is already gone. Hours pass until night falls, but he fails to remember anything...

3113.text:
No. 7 walks for a long time, trailing behind the cat. Before long, they reach a path marked by a sign that reads, "Lakeside trail."
"This is it! This is the path we took...!"
He looks down at the cat in surprise, but the cat is nowhere to be seen.
"Where did it go?"
He looks around, but doesn't see it anywhere.
"... Thank you for helping me." 
He turns his gaze to the trail he has walked countless times. His eyes then shift to the blue roses blooming on the roadside.
"Oh..."
With their beautiful blue hue, the flowers remind him of Marian. Every time he came across them, he always wanted to pick one to give to her. But now... he's having a hard time even remembering the delight on Marian's face when he gave her that one.
"..."
He picks a rose and slips it into his pocket.
"... I need to pick up the pace."

3114.text:
After walking down the trail for what seems like forever, No. 7 arrives at the lake. Just like that day, it glistens under the sun. He thinks back on the time he and Marian stood over the water, taking in the view together.
"Wow, just look at that. It's so pretty." He remembers smiling. "What do you think, Marian? This is nice, right? It really helps clear your mind."
"[[REDACT]]Huh[[/REDACT]]...? I..." She hesitated for a moment, and then...
"... Yeah, it really is [[REDACT]]pret[[/REDACT]]ty," she replied with a bright smile.
"..."
Just one more time... He wanted to see this lake with her just one more time. He wanted to see her smile again.
"I have to go..."
If he ever hopes to make that a reality, he has to somehow hold on to his disappearing memories. He turns and walks away, leaving the glistening lake behind him.

3115.text: No. 7 knows that he needs to get past the lake and head to the new city, but he realizes he can no longer remember the way. He frantically looks around and...

options.text: Decides to swim across the lake.

3116.text:
"I think I remember going into the water."
He gazes at the lake.
"I'm not sure if I should really go in, but... I'm sure it's better than doing nothing."
He takes a deep breath, then plunges into the water with a splash.
"?!"
Despite his confident dive, his body grows heavier and heavier. He slowly begins to sink deeper...

3117.text:
No. 7 watches as the deer walks toward the northern forest, its hooves rustling through the fallen leaves.
"That reminds me of... that one time..."
He recalls seeing a family of deer with Marian.
"I know the next thing I want to do after [[REDACT]]our picnic[[/REDACT]]," she said.
When she asked what he wanted, he said, "A daughter, I think. Because she'd take after you."
Then she said, "Hahaha. [[REDACT]]That's the same reason I thought a son would be nice.[[/REDACT]]"
Wait...
[[REDACT]]"Hahaha. That's the same reason I thought a son would be nice."[[/REDACT]]
He can't remember her response at all.
"No... I can't just forget...!"

options.text: Scramble after the deer to the northern forest.

3119.text:
No. 7 jolts awake and opens his eyes.
He pushes himself up and finds himself on the ground near the lake.
"The last thing I remember is looking out at the lake..."
He must have blacked out for a moment.
"Is this a side effect of me losing my memories...?"
He slaps both of his cheeks.
"Snap out of it...! This isn't the time to be passing out..." he says, scolding himself. "I'm going to end up forgetting Marian at this rate, and that's the one thing I cannot allow."
He staggers as he rises to his feet.
"Time to go."
He presses forward.

3120.text:
However, no matter how thoroughly he searches the forest, the deer is nowhere in sight. He lets out a heavy sigh. To make matters worse, maneuvering through the forest while avoiding Raptures has sapped far more of his stamina than usual. He is already at his limit.
A wave of dizziness washes over No. 7, and he grabs hold of a nearby tree.
"I shouldn't be... wasting time like this..."

3121.text:
"I think I'd like to pack a lunch and go on a picnic."
That's right. She wanted to go on a picnic. To a lake, right?
"A park would be lovely too. I want to spread a blanket on a grassy patch and sit."
They decided on a lakeside park.
"Oh, and a lunch box. I want [[REDACT]]a really cute one[[/REDACT]]."
What did she want again...? Whatever it was, they settled it with a round of rock-paper-scissors...
"Just so you know, I'm going with [[REDACT]]scissors[[/REDACT]]."
He wanted to let her take the one she liked. What did she say she was going with?
"Here goes. Rock..."
What does he need to choose to let her win? He has to remember so that she can choose the lunchbox...!
"Paper..."
Remember... remember!
"Forget me."
Wait... when did he hear those words?
"Forget all of this and go live. Our story ends here."
That's not at all what he wants.
"I love you."
He refuses to let it end here... not like this!
"Here goes. Rock, paper... scissors!"

3122.text:
"Ah, darn. Looks like I lost, huh?" he said.
Then, as though she knew he lost on purpose...
"So, we agree on getting a cute lunch box?"
... She smiled radiantly. "I really hope we can go."
He has to go. He has to.
In order to be with her, he will...

3123.text:
"!!!"
No. 7 opens his eyes. He sees a tree above him. He sits up.
"We have to go... on that picnic. We have to bring that cute lunchbox...!"
He takes a deep breath.
"If I leave right away, though, I'll just collapse again. I should eat something first..."
He pulls out a piece of jerky he had been saving just in case.
"..."
There's no one for him to share with. Even his memory of that day is hazy now. He stuffs the jerky into his mouth and desperately tries to think back. After eating, they ran away from something. He doesn't remember what it was...
"But I know for sure we left the northern forest, which means... I need to head toward the walking trail to the south."
He gets to his feet and makes his way toward the trail.

3124.text:
No. 7 runs along the walking trail toward the new city. He spots a giant collapsed building with a gaping hole in its center.
"We were here, and we..."
Fought against something. What was it?

3125.text:
"Right. It was a huge Rapture."
He glances at the gaping hole in the center of the building.
"And that's the damage from when we fought it."

3126.text:
"No. If it were a pack of Raptures..."
He glances at the gaping hole in the center of the building.
"They couldn't have left a hole like that."
He concentrates, trying to remember again.

3127.text:
"It kept attacking us with its tentacles... and we died several times as we tried to escape."
He looks at the base of the collapsed building.
"At one point, we even hid under the building. We came up with a plan there, and..."
He shifts his gaze to the building's outer wall.
"We climbed up that outer wall. As part of our plan to defeat the thing, I..."

3128.text:
"Me as bait? Did I really manage to dodge the Rapture's attacks?"
He stares at the collapsed building.
"I don't think I would've had the stamina for that..."
He concentrates, trying to remember again.

3129.text:
"That's right. I pulled the lever... We trapped it inside the building and electrocuted it. Then we both shot it before it could move it tentacles again..."
It's as if he can hear the echoes of that day once more. There was a flurry of gunshots, and...
"Please...!"
"Break!"
The core began to crack.
"And that's when we broke the Black Smith's core...!" he exclaims. "That's right! It was a Black Smith. We defeated a Black Smith!"
He is filled with hope as the forgotten name returns to him.
"I need to hurry... I have to get to the new city!"
He sprints forward.

3130.text:
Filled with hope, No. 7 runs toward the new city.
His approach is working.
"If I just keep revisiting these places and thinking back, then I'll naturally start to remember Maria-n..."

3131.text:
"What did I just say...? Maria-...n? Maria-n?!"
No. 7 punches himself hard in the face. He keeps at it until his face begins to swell.
"No. No, no! Get your head on straight!" he says desperately. "I have to get to the church! If I can just make it to the church, then..."
Wait...
Why was he going to the church?

3132.text:
No. 7 looks up at the city before him. The entrance to what was once known as the new city is bathed in the golden glow of the sunset.
"This is where we were when she told me... We talked about something she wanted to do...!"
When exactly... was that?
What was the color of the sky then?
Blue?
Golden?
Or was it red?
"Remember... remember...!"

3133.text:
He tries to recall that conversation again.
"[[REDACT]]I'd like to live until my hair turns gray[[/REDACT]]."
He had gazed at her, surprised.
"[[REDACT]]If we're to live together until our hair turns gray, we should at least get married, right[[/REDACT]]? [[REDACT]]As for the venue[[/REDACT]]..." That's when she looked into the distance. "[[REDACT]]Way over there... It looks like there's a church. It'd be nice to hold it somewhere like that, don't you think[[/REDACT]]?"
...
He can't remember it very well.

3135.text:
He doesn't remember.
He cannot remember her name!
"Agh... Aghhh... Arggghhh...!"
No. 7 slams his head on the ground.
"Please...! Just think...! Please...! Remember!"
He continues to slam his head.
"Please...!"
Something falls from his pocket.

3136.text:
A blue rose. It's the blue rose he had picked from the trail.
With its beautiful blue hue, the flower reminds him of...

3137.text:
"Marian!"
No. 7 rises to his feet.
"I'm going to the church. I have to go, even if I don't know the reason. I have to go...!
He picks up the blue rose and starts running toward the church.

3138.text:
The church doors open with a loud creak. Particles of dust drift through the air, shimmering in the haze of the moonlight. All is still, until...
No. 7 comes rushing in.
"Mari[[REDACT]]an[[/REDACT]]... [[REDACT]]Mari[[/REDACT]]an... Ma[[REDACT]]ri[[/REDACT]]an... Mari[[REDACT]]an[[/REDACT]]...!"
Even as he repeats her name again and again, his memory fades.

3139.text:
"Right... I need to write it down...!"
He frantically scrambles over to the altar. He bites his finger hard and begins writing with his blood.
"Ma...ri...[[REDACT]]an[[/REDACT]]?"
Wait...
"Ma...[[REDACT]]ri[[/REDACT]]...[[REDACT]]an[[/REDACT]]..."
... No. No, no, no.
"[[REDACT]]Ma[[/REDACT]]...ri...[[REDACT]]an[[/REDACT]]..."
No...!
"[[REDACT]]Ma[[/REDACT]]...[[REDACT]]ri[[/REDACT]]...[[REDACT]]an[[/REDACT]]..."
[[REDACT]]Marian[[/REDACT]]... [[REDACT]]Marian[[/REDACT]]... [[REDACT]]Marian[[/REDACT]]! [[REDACT]]Marian[[/REDACT]]!
He falls down in front of the altar.
"Please... Please... Don't disappear..."

3140.text:
The church doors creak open once more.
Someone steps inside.
He hears the sound of heels clacking against the floor.
Just like on the happiest day of his life.
Dressed in... [[REDACT]]a white wedding dress[[/REDACT]]?
"Commander."

3141.text:
It's her.
"I knew you'd be here..."

3142.text:
"!!!"
He can't call her name. He can't remember the name he used to call her.
"Agh... Aggghhh...!"
He falls into despair.
In a last-ditch attempt to remember, he looks up at her.

3143.text:
"?!"
Is he out of stamina...?
His vision grows blurry.
"Agh..."
His strength starts to sap. He can't even lift his head.
"What's... happening to me...?"
He hears something buzz. His ears seem to be ringing, too.
"I think... *bzzt...* shock from cutting your NIMPH... *Bzzt...* side effect... *Bzzt...* be temporary..."
His eyes slowly start to close.

3144.text:
"You're falling... *bzzt...* when you... *bzzt...* up, everything... *bzzt...* okay..."
He hears her heels again.
[[REDACT]]MarianMarianMarian[[/REDACT]]
She's approaching him.
[[REDACT]]Marian[[/REDACT]]...
[[REDACT]]Marian[[/REDACT]]...!
[[REDACT]]Marian[[/REDACT]]!
No...! Please...!
"Let's go back now, Commander."
He struggles with everything he has to keep his eyes open...!

3146.text:
[[REDACT]]MarianMarianMarianMarianMarian[[/REDACT]]
[[REDACT]]MarianMarianMarianMarianMarianMarian[[/REDACT]]
[[REDACT]]MarianMarianMarianMarianMarian[[/REDACT]]...
She smiles, her eyes brimming with tears.

6101.text: With a harrowing crash, a ground-type Rapture leaps over the building and lands directly on top of Maria. Crushed beneath its weight, Maria is killed instantly without so much as a proper scream.

ending.title: The Consequence of Carelessness
ending.hint: Never let your guard down on the surface.

6102.text:
An arrow whistles through the air and pierces Maria's head, sending her crumpling to the floor.
Her eyes, now adjusted to the darkness, spot a crossbow trap hidden on the wall in the far corner of the storeroom, as well as the silhouette of a hunter crouching beneath it.
A cat sits curled up beside the hunter. It lets out a soft meow as it opens its eyes and stares at her. She stares back before losing consciousness.

ending.title: A Hunter's Room
ending.hint: Watch your surroundings when entering dark areas.

6103.text:
Maria pokes her head out of the convenience store and looks toward the approaching Raptures.
"There's still some distance between us. I just need to run."
She sprints forward, and immediately hears something whizzing up in the air.
"!!!"
An aerial-type Rapture has its barrel trained on her.
[[REDACT]]I'm scared.[[/REDACT]]
"Oh..."
With a deafening bang, a shot tears through her body.

ending.title: Like a Thief in the... Day
ending.hint: Avoid moving around when Raptures are also on the move.

6104.text:
Drawing on the combat experience she's gained through her countless deaths, Maria manages to defeat the pack of Raptures.
"I did it!" she cries.
However...
"... Huh?"
A group of aerial-type Raptures that were hidden behind a building suddenly dive down and attack. They knock her to the ground.
"I didn't... see them..."
Unable to stave off the attack, Maria is killed as one of the Raptures' attacks pierces through her abdomen.

ending.title: More Than Meets the Eye
ending.hint: Make sure to properly assess the enemy's numbers before attacking.

6105.text:
"Argh...!"
Before Maria can find somewhere to take cover, a swarm of aerial-type Raptures rush over. She fights back with all her might, but before long, she is killed by a beam that pierces her core.

ending.title: Nowhere to Hide
ending.hint: There's nowhere to take cover in the middle of a large road.

6106.text:
How much longer does she have to run?
As she tries to avoid Raptures coming at her head-on and from behind, Maria ends up having to run for far longer than she expected. Nikkes shouldn't be capable of running out of breath, yet Maria strangely finds herself struggling as though she were.
As her stamina nears its limit, a sense of helplessness washes over her. She just wants to give up.
The thought stops Maria in her tracks.
"I guess this time was a failure. I'll just start over."
The aerial-type Raptures close in and get Maria in their sights.
[[REDACT]]I'm scared.[[/REDACT]]
"... Huh?"
Immediately, a Rapture beam pierces her head.

ending.title: Stamina Limit
ending.hint: Managing your stamina is essential.

6107.text:
However, Maria's gun can't shoot far enough to reach the aerial-type Raptures.
"Oh no...!"
She panics, realizing that all she did was give away her position. A moment later, a Rapture beam pierces her head.

ending.title: Out of Range
ending.hint: Make sure you know your weapon's effective range.

6108.text:
In one swift motion, the Black Smith swallows her whole.
Her body cracks and twists.
It sizzles and melts.
[[REDACT]]"My skin my head my face my whole body is melting"[[/REDACT]]
Death slowly eats away at Maria.
"[[REDACT]]I'mscared[[/REDACT]]I'm[[REDACT]]scaredI'mscaredI'm[[/REDACT]]sca[[REDACT]]redI'mscaredI'msca[[/REDACT]]red"
[[REDACT]]"Ithurtsithurtsithurtsithurtsithurtsithurtsithurtsithurtsithurts!"[[/REDACT]]
[[REDACT]]"I want to die please just let me"[[/REDACT]]
She blacks out.

ending.title: Beware After Dark
ending.hint: Find somewhere to set up camp before nightfall.

6109.text:
Maria pants heavily, struggling to catch her breath. She should be safe here... right? She nervously paces back and forth.
Suddenly, she loses her balance and trips, slamming into a pillar. Pieces of rubble rain down over her head.
"Rubble...?"
She looks up at the ceiling, and... there's a crack! It's growing bigger, seemingly due to her hitting the pillar.
"I have to get out of here...!"
Before she can escape the building, the ceiling rumbles and comes crashing down onto Maria.

ending.title: Choose Your Real Estate Carefully
ending.hint: Choose your shelter carefully, even when in a hurry.

6110.text:
"I can't even die properly."
Maria hears the thumping of Raptures' footsteps as they rush toward the sound of the gunshot.
"Well, I'm going to die anyway..."
The gun clicks as she once again raises the muzzle to her chin, trembling. However, she still can't bring herself to pull the trigger.
"Haha... Hahaha...!"
She starts to laugh, but it sounds more like she's crying.
Not long after, a Rapture that was roaming nearby lands atop the building she is in with a loud thud.
Death comes crashing down upon her.

ending.title: The Shot Heard Round the Surface
ending.hint: If you fire a gun when you're hiding, you're no longer hiding!

6111.text:
Maria comes to the conclusion that there is no meaning to this life. Strangely enough, the lighter the weight of life becomes, the lighter death feels.
She is no longer afraid of anything. She laughs.
"So this is how it feels... This must be how that person in the convenience store felt, too."
She pulls the trigger.
Life collapses at the sound of a gunshot.

ending.title: The Collapse of Life
ending.hint: Find a moment when life shines.

6112.text:
The untangled cord flutters in the air. With a refreshing swoosh, the bird casts off its restraints and soars into the sky toward the light.
Enchanted by its sparkling beauty and the sight of it flying free, Maria gazes blankly up at the sky.
Her heavy body hits the lake with a splash. As she sinks down, she continues to stare upward until she can no longer breathe and loses consciousness.

ending.title: The Soaring Bird
ending.hint: Perhaps there are more than two options that will lead you forward.

6201.text:
Marian tilts her head, pondering for a while, before finally looking up at the Commander with determination.
"I'll go ahead and die first so I can remember!"
"Wait, Marian...!"
With a solemn expression on her face, Maria raises the gun to her head. "I'll be right back!"
A gunshot rings out.

ending.title: Be Right Back?
ending.hint: Retrace Maria's memories.

6202.text:
The ground rumbles.
Having heard Marian's gunshot, the Raptures begin to gather.
"How are there this many...?!"
Marian and the Commander struggle desperately to fend them off...
"I can't see... with all these trees in the way...!"
Unable to see all of their incoming assailants, they fail to hold off the swarming Raptures. The Commander hears the sound of a laser.
"Watch out, Marian!" He jumps in front of her.
With a blast, a gaping hole opens in his abdomen.
"Commander...?"
He dies instantly.
"No...!"
Moments later, there's a hole blasted in Marian's body as well, and she loses consciousness.

ending.title: Overreaction
ending.hint: Overreacting does not always turn out well.

6203.text:
The Commander wheezes out ragged breaths as his stamina reaches its limit.
"Come on," Marian says, "let's hide over here and catch our breath." She pulls him along and helps him sit down behind a giant tree.
"Agh... S-sorry..."
"I'll go out there and act as bait. Take your time and follow after me when you're ready, okay?"
"What...? No...!"
"I'll go on ahead!"
The moment she dashes out from behind the tree to act as bait, an aerial-type Rapture fires a beam and hits the trunk of the giant tree. The tree topples over with a harrowing crunch.
"Commander!"
Surprised but unable to dodge the falling tree, the Commander gets crushed beneath it.
"No!"
Marian tries to pull him out from under the tree, but another attack launched by an aerial-type Rapture strikes her, and she collapses beside him.

ending.title: What's the Farthest You've Ever Run?
ending.hint: Blindly running will only draw unwanted attention.

6204.text:
The Commander throws himself in front of Marian.
The Black Smith's tentacle pierces through his abdomen with ease.
"Commander...?"
The Commander clutches the tentacle with all his might. "You... can't... have... her...!"
"Commander...!"
He coughs and yells out desperately. "Run...!"
"I can't just leave you behind!"
She starts firing at the Black Smith.
However...
"Mari...an...!"
Raptures swarm toward the sound of the gunfire and kill Marian.
"No...!"
Before long, the Commander bleeds to death.

ending.title: You Can't Have Her
ending.hint: You have to move quickly if you're going to shake off your pursuer.

6205.text:
"Quick, let's hide!"
The two of them take cover behind a tree before the Raptures swarm in.
Branches break overhead.
With their senses dulled from exhaustion, they fail to sense the Rapture coming from above, and they get trampled to death.

ending.title: The Consequence of Starvation
ending.hint: Rest and eat whenever you can.

6206.text:
A strong electrical current zaps through Marian's body. She falls to the floor without even a chance to scream.
"No...!" the Commander yells out.
Only then does she notice the damaged cables dangling from the ceiling, dipped in water.
"Ah... Ahh..."
As she loses consciousness, she hopes the Commander won't push himself too hard trying to save her.

ending.title: Beware of Electricity
ending.hint: Hiding without a plan isn't always the best choice.

6207.text:
"Commander...! Run...!"
Ensnared by one of the Black Smith's tentacles, Marian soars into the air. She confirms that no other tentacles are coming for the Commander.
Relieved that she was able to save him, she surrenders herself to a familiar death as her body snaps and cracks.

ending.title: A Fulfilling Sacrifice
ending.hint: The experiences you gain from death after death will be your key to victory.

6208.text:
The glass shatters.
"Marian!"
The Commander grabs her hand as she falls, but he's unable to pull her up, and instead tumbles through the window with her. They both land in the lake water pooled inside the building with a loud splash and sink down.

ending.title: Watch Your Feet
ending.hint: A typical window cannot hold a Nikke's weight.

6209.text:
Just then, a sharp whoosh cuts through the air.
"Huh?"
One of the Black Smith's tentacles snatches Marian up.
"I was too slow...!"
Marian's body soars into the air before getting swallowed whole. Regretting that she hadn't run as fast as she could, she surrenders herself to the familiar death. Somewhere in the distance, she thinks she hears the Commander scream.

ending.title: Are You Here on a Stroll?
ending.hint: You have to give it everything you've got to succeed!

6210.text:
That afternoon...
A beam of light flies through the air.
"Marian!"
Completely distracted, Marian dies from a laser from an aerial-type Rapture. As her consciousness slips away, she still cannot find the answers to the questions that linger in her heart.

ending.title: Endless Questions
ending.hint: Remember those nagging feelings you had during your time with the Commander.

6211.text:
Marian sits on the windowsill.
"Commander." Her vision grows increasingly red.
"What're you doing? Sitting there's dangerous...!"
"Once we start over, I promise I'll be faster next time."
He reaches his hand out toward her.
"Goodbye... for now."
She surrenders her body to the red sky.
A flower falls to the ground.

ending.title: Goodbye For Now
ending.hint: May you be able to make a different choice the next time you try.

6301.text:
"I won't get anywhere like this..."
Overcome with anxiety, No. 7 closes his eyes to recall his past memories. A sleep akin to death overcomes him.

ending.title: Lost Memories
ending.hint: Try to retrace your memories of Marian.

7101.text:
As she fights the Black Smith, Maria starts muttering to herself.
"I have to kill it."
And she keeps muttering.
"I have to kill it. I have to kill it. I have to kill it. I have to kill it."
She lowers her gun.
"I have to kill it."
Raptures swarm around her, shaking the ground as they lift her off her feet. She doesn't fight back. The thuds from their steps fade into the distance as they carry her away.
Maria stares blankly ahead, her eyes having turned red.

ending.title: I H■v■ t■ ■il■ ■t?
ending.hint: Beware of the Black Smith's tentacles.

7201.text:
The round Marian fired tears through the man's body with a deafening bang. He crumples to the floor. His hand stretches out towards her feet, but it falls limp to the floor before it can reach her.
She gazes apathetically at him, her eyes glowing red, and then she walks out of the building.

ending.title: W■ ■ho■l■ ■o?
ending.hint: The chances of getting corrupted increase as time passes.

7202.text:
The man fires at the tentacles whipping toward them from afar.
"Argh... Is it after Marian?!"
Again and again, the tentacles keep reaching for Marian.
A flurry of gunshots echoes through the forest.
"I I I have have have to to to go go go..." Marian stretches her arm out toward an incoming tentacle.
"Marian, no!"
The man grabs her arm. A muted shot rings out from behind.
"Urk!"
Shot from behind by a Rapture, the man collapses to the ground as the tentacle ensnares Marian.
"I won't... let you..." The man stretches out his arm. "... take... her..."
The light fades from his eyes. She stares at him, her expression blank as the Black Smith's tentacle drags her away.

ending.title: I H■v■ ■o G■?
ending.hint: Once corrupted, Marian is able to send out a calling signal.

7203.text:
The round strikes the pillar beside Marian. At the same time, she begins to push herself up, but the Commander pulls her into a desperate embrace before she can fully rise to her feet.
"Let go of me."
The pillar cracks.
"I'm sorry, Marian..."
The crack spreads.
"Let go of me."
"There's no way... I could possibly shoot you."
She hits him with her hand.
"Let go of me."
"Ugh... I'm sorry... I'm so sorry...!"
The pillar crumbles.
"Let go of me."
No matter how many times she strikes him, he refuses to let go.
"I promise... I won't leave you alone. Ever...!"
"Let go of me. Let go of me. Let go of me. Let go of me."
"I'm sorry, Marian... I'm sorry...!"
Even as the ceiling crashes down around them, he refuses to let go of her.

ending.title: L■t ■■ o■ ■e?
ending.hint: Fleeing isn't always the best choice.

7204.text:
"Please move."
The man stands firmly in front of Marian as she tries to leave.
"Please move."
"I'm sorry, Marian..."
She raises her gun and clicks it.
"I just don't think I can shoot you..."
"Please move. Please move. Please move. Please move."
"... I'm sorry."
She pulls the trigger and a loud bang echoes through the room. Without the slightest emotion, she stares at him as he lifelessly falls to the ground. Then she walks outside.

ending.title: P■ea■■ ■ov■?
ending.hint: Recall your past failures.

7205.text:
The man's hand trembles as though he senses his own impending doom.
"It's okay. I'll be okay..." The man looks at Marian, his eyes brimming with tears. "So don't cry, all right?"
Tears roll down Marian's cheeks. She wipes them away, looking confused.
"You're still in there, even now." The man smiles. "That's all I need to know. The only thing that matters is that it's still you, Marian."
"I'm going."
"I promise to start moving faster..."
"I'm going."
"So next time..."
A gunshot rips through the air.
"... Let's go together."
The man falls to the ground, staining it red. Marian coldly wipes the splatter from her cheek and vanishes into the ruined city.

ending.title: I'■ ■o■■g?
ending.hint: It's time to start again.

8101.text:
"Please delete this memory, Doctor," Maria pleads. "I tried to betray you."
"What are you..."
Maria raises her gun and presses the muzzle against the underside of her chin.
"Maria-n...?"
"Doctor," Maria whispers, "do we still share the same fate?"
The doctor grows quiet, and then...
"Yeah..."
Maria smiles.
"Good. I'm glad."
She pulls the trigger.

8201.text:
"I'd like to live until my hair turns gray."
"... What?" The Commander gazes at Marian with a look of surprise.
"You'll probably have a lot of gray hair by then too, right?"
"I suppose so... But I don't think I'll look quite as charming by then."
"Of course you will." Marian returns his gaze. "I'm sure you'll still be handsome at that age."
"And you'll still be beautiful."
"You think so?" Marian giggles. "Hmm... I'd like to have a wedding, too."
"A wedding?"
"If we're to live together until our hair turns gray, we should at least get married, right?"
The Commander stares at Marian in stunned silence for a moment, then lets out a hearty, happy laugh. "Haha! Of course! I'll have to get you a ring."
"Please pick out something pretty." She smiles. "Something I can wear every day."
"It'll be the prettiest ring you've ever seen."
"As for the venue..." Marian looks into the distance. "Do you see that over there?"
"Where?"
"Way over there... It looks like there's a church. It'd be nice to hold it somewhere like that, don't you think?"
"Yeah, that would be amazing."
The two of them look at each other and smile brightly beneath the blue sky, basking in the warm sunlight.
"... Shall we get going, then?" He offers his hand.
"Yeah, let's." She takes his hand in hers.
Together, they walk toward the future.

8301.text:
I open my eyes at the sound of a mechanical whirr.
"Huh...?"
I find myself inside a transport ship that feels both familiar and alien at the same time.
"You're... already awake."
A woman looks at me with surprise on her face before gently smiling.
"Hi. I've been assigned to this mission with you. I'm..." She trails off. "A Nikke."
For some reason, just looking at her...
"I look forward to working with you today."
... makes me want to cry.
"Yeah. I look forward to..."
Suddenly, I start to sway. For some reason, I feel dizzy.
"Are you okay? Feeling dizzy?"
"No, I'm all..."
Drowsiness rushes in.
"Sorry. I'm a little tired..."
"That's understandable. We still have some time before we get to where we're going, so you should try to get some more sleep."
She gently lays me back down.
"Sorry... I'll only sleep... for a little bit."
"Sure. Don't worry about me... And good night, Commander."
I close my eyes.
"Everything will be over when you wake up."
My consciousness drifts away.
"Goodbye, my..."
The world goes dark.

9101.text:
Maria runs toward the mountains. She desperately races to break free from the cycle that shackles her.
"Haha... hahaha... hahaha!"
The butterfly that craved freedom finally flutters beyond her prison, with tears in her eyes. She can no longer hear Doctor Maria's voice.

9201.text:
A gunshot rings out as a bullet tears through the Commander's head.
"Com...mander...?"
Blood she's seen all too often sprays from the Commander's wound as he collapses to the ground. Marian screams as she turns toward the shooter.
"Wh-what the...?!"
She finds herself staring at Maria.
"Oh, it was still going on."
Maria stares back at Marian.
"I'm sorry."
Another gunshot.
"I'm going to be free."
Now, only one free butterfly remains.
"This place isn't safe anymore... I need to go somewhere else."
She flies off to a more distant place.
